summary: John's 5th great-aunt; infant sister of Agatha Heizler.
bio: Died of measles aged about 1½, 'Tochter des Joseph Heizler'; witness Johann Federer. (Her age suggests a birth c.late 1813, close to Agatha's June 1813 birth — not resolved; ages in death entries are approximate.)
